none: PAS LANCUM-325007: Roman coin silver denarius of Antoninus Pius Reece Period 7
contea di ritrovamento: Gloucestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ is ANTONINVS AVG PIVS P P TR P XI ; R/ is COS IIII

A clipped silver Denarius of Antoninus Pius dating to the period AD 147 to 148 (Reece Period 7). Reverse type COS IIII Annona. Cf RIC 3 (Antoninus), 162. The diameter is 17mm. The obverse inscription is ANTONINVS AVG PIVS P P TR P XI and the reverse inscription is COS IIII
